sessionHeader: SYNTHETIC SESSION. Fictional client c02 (Rohan M.), session 2026-10-12. Not a real person.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Rohan, welcome back. It's been two weeks. How have things been at home?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Better with my partner. The shared feed schedule is working. I get two nights of proper sleep now.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's a big change. How's your mood on those days?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Less flat. I'd say five out of ten instead of three.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Did you manage the walks with your daughter?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Three times last week. She falls asleep in the carrier, it's nice.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That sounds like a good moment. Anything that got in the way of the walks?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Rain, mostly. And work calls.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Could an indoor version count on rainy days?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Maybe playing music with her in the evening. She likes that.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Let's count that. Now, last time you mentioned the psychiatry follow-up. Did that happen?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: No, I missed it. I had a work trip and forgot to reschedule.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Okay. How have you been finding the medicine?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: I feel a bit dizzy in the mornings. I was thinking of just stopping it.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's important to tell Dr. K. I can't advise on the medication myself, but I'd like you to talk to Dr. K. before changing anything. Would it help if we booked that follow-up now?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes, please. Evenings only, though.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: I'll ask the team to find an evening slot with Dr. K. this week and send it to you by SMS.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: How about the conflict script, did you use it again?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Once. It went okay. I forgot the "what I need" part.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: That's often the hardest part. For this fortnight, try it once more and finish with the need, even a small one.

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Fine.

lines.speaker: T
lines.text: Same time in two weeks, evening?

lines.speaker: C
lines.text: Yes.
